scope: First 8 public dev programs; diagnostic only; 96 candidate assessments and 42 queries
request_groups: Replay original decide-340m dev trace candidate groups; split binary tasks into groups of at most 8 for native inference
execution: Sequential inference after CPU-heavy setup complete. Downloads and build parallel.
score_composition: independent-positive-negative-product; unchanged engine hard-label decision and exact query evaluation
calibration: Publisher calibration only; no benchmark tuning
gold_policy: Read public dev gold only after all 8 model predictions sealed; no tuning from scores
timing: Run wall clock includes model initialization and checksum verification, excludes download/build; archived H2O timing historical and not controlled contemporaneous speed comparison
serialization_note: K2 native Python encoder preserves yes/no option insertion order. Lux native nlohmann JSON iterates choice criteria sorted as no/yes. Semantic questions/descriptions unchanged; no option-order tuning.
